audited_source_corrections.rationale: The second conclusion has A XOR B to the left of the sequent sign, so its rule is LeftR. A sequent Gamma entails Delta is true exactly when some formula in Gamma is false or some formula in Delta is true. Adding A on the right preserves an existing witness regardless of A's value, whereas the converse can fail when the added A alone is true.
